tools.name: classify_keywords_simple
tools.description: Classify keywords locally by intent, funnel stage, brand type, and topic. Free and available without an API key.

tools.name: seo_checklist
tools.description: Get an SEO checklist. Types: general, blog, ecommerce, discover, backlink, all. Available in English and German. Free - no API key required.

tools.name: seo_guidance
tools.description: Get SEO best practices on a topic. Topics: title_tags, meta_descriptions, heading_structure, internal_linking, core_web_vitals, eeat, keyword_research, schema_markup, image_optimization, local_seo. Use topic='list' for all. Free - no API key required.

tools.name: analyze_url_structure
tools.description: Analyze a URL for SEO-friendliness. Checks length, structure, and common issues. Free - no API key required.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List available countries/locations for SEO data queries. Free - no API key required.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get an SEO workflow skill with step-by-step methodology, triggers, credits, and quality gates from the current seo_skills catalog. Use name='list' for all available skills. Free - no API key required.

tools.name: get_google_guidelines
tools.description: Get official Google Search developer guidelines by category. Free.

findings.detail: Tool "get_auth_status" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
